blind.description: A decorative wooden architectural bracket or corbel. It features a vertical wall-mounting plate with circular bolt heads, a flat rectangular top support surface, and an ornate curved S-scroll underneath adorned with carved green acanthus leaves against a dark red recessed background. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized wood textures and no floating or broken elements.
blind.from_above: A simple horizontal rectangle of wood with rounded corners, showing the slight rounded spine of the back plate on the left side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 ft tall) and about 1.5 ft deep.

notes: footprint proportion 1.69x off the catalog (2.0 x 1.1 ft)
